correctness.rationale: Independent uniform-parent restrictions given exact subtree membership produce two independent recursive trees. Pólya-urn recursion proves B uniform. Eulerian recurrence for leaves and geometric-series Laurent expansion prove cumulants kappa_j(L_d)=d beta_j/j below order d; the explicit first omitted coefficient yields kappa_2h(L_2h)=0. Additivity proves exact moments and nonzero Bernoulli defect at boundary; direct endpoint conditional means give covariance. The source package verification.py independently exhausts trees n<=9 and performs 6586 exact assertions; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first root-branch size is uniform and records an important macroscopic split, whereas total leaves is a canonical recursive-tree shape statistic. The proof shows an arbitrarily high but sharply finite hierarchy of moments entirely blind to that split in a bulk range, with the first detectable even-order moment at an exact cutoff and a nonzero Bernoulli defect. This structural conditional-moment phenomenon, rather than a routine mean computation, distinguishes finite-dimensional shape statistics from the full joint law and motivates efficient conditional approximations. The covariance is an additional boundary-localization consequence, not the sole result.
